name: MIMSpell3
fix_description: _additionalCookAction is an empty virtual function that returns a default CookStatus (all fields false). When cook calls it for action=0, the returned status overwrites the existing status including needsSolvencyCheck=true set by prior borrow actions. Fix by preserving the incoming status fields in the return value, or not allowing action=0 to overwrite the solvency check flag.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward arbitrary-call/token-drain style exploit: deposit shares into the swapper, craft malicious swapData, and invoke swap so the vulnerable contract swaps its own USDT to MIM for the attacker. It is a short PoC with only a few external calls and requires limited protocol-specific knowledge beyond recognizing unsafe external call handling.
